versions.changelog:
cjournal-ai-paper-skill 1.0.0

- Initial release of a reusable AI-assisted toolset for writing and editing Chinese C-journal-style academic papers.
- Supports mechanism-focused papers in journalism, education governance, and public administration.
- Emphasizes research question development, literature review synthesis, analytical frameworks, typified empirical materials, mechanism modeling, standardized referencing, and C-journal stylistic polish.
- Provides detailed workflows, standards for structuring, citation, tables, figures, and dos/don'ts for scholarly quality assurance.
